You can't reach an `a` without an `href` with the Tab key, and it isn't announced as a link. An `a` with `href="#"` or `href="javascript:..."` and an `onClick` is announced as a link but acts like a button. Space doesn't press it, and "open in new tab" leads nowhere.

Use `a` with a real address to go somewhere. Use `button` to do something.

- An `href` is missing if it has no value, or is `null` or `undefined`.
- An `href` is invalid if it's `""` or `"#"`, or starts with `javascript:`.
- A link with spread props and no `href` isn't reported, because the `href` might be in the spread.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jsx-a11y/anchor-is-valid" = "error" # or "warn"
```

Every option, set to its default. The ones that are commented out are unset by default.

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jsx-a11y/anchor-is-valid" = ["error", {
  components = [], # list of strings
  specialLink = [], # list of strings
  # aspects = <list of strings>,
}]
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 3} */}
```jsx
const home = <a>Home</a>;
const top = <a href="#">Back to top</a>;
const save = <a href="#" onClick={saveDraft}>Save</a>;
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
const home = <a href="/">Home</a>;
const top = <a href="#top">Back to top</a>;
const save = <button onClick={saveDraft}>Save</button>;
const tracked = <a href="/pricing" onClick={trackClick}>Pricing</a>;
const docs = <a {...linkProps}>Docs</a>;
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `components` | `[]` | Components to check like `a`. |
| `specialLink` | `[]` | Other attributes that count as `href`. |
| `aspects` | all three | Which checks run: `"noHref"` (no `href`), `"invalidHref"` (an `href` that goes nowhere), `"preferButton"` (an `onClick` with a missing or invalid `href`). |

{/* bad {"options": [{"components": ["Link"], "specialLink": ["to"]}]} */}
```jsx
const home = <Link>Home</Link>;
```

{/* good {"options": [{"components": ["Link"], "specialLink": ["to"]}]} */}
```jsx
const home = <Link to="/">Home</Link>;
```

With only `"invalidHref"`, a link without an `href` is allowed:

{/* good {"options": [{"aspects": ["invalidHref"]}]} */}
```jsx
const home = <a>Home</a>;
```
